import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static class MaxFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, cap, flow;
            Edge(int to, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = 0;
            }
        }

        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> g;
        boolean[] used;
        int n;

        MaxFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            used = new boolean[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            edges.add(new Edge(to, cap));
            edges.add(new Edge(from, 0));
            g.get(from).add(edges.size() - 2);
            g.get(to).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int T, int curFlow) {
            if (v == T) return true;
            used[v] = true;
            for (int idx : g.get(v)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (!used[e.to] && e.cap - e.flow >= curFlow && dfs(e.to, T, curFlow)) {
                    e.flow += curFlow;
                    edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= curFlow;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
            int flow = 0;
            int curFlow = 1 << 30;
            while (curFlow > 0) {
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
                if (dfs(S, T, curFlow)) {
                    flow += curFlow;
                } else {
                    curFlow >>= 1;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a, b;
    static int[][] dist;
    static boolean[][] usedGrid;

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n && 0 <= y && y < n && a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        dist = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        qx.add(x);
        qy.add(y);
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = cx + dx[k];
                int ty = cy + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[cx][cy] + 1;
                    qx.add(tx);
                    qy.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y, MaxFlow maxFlow) {
        usedGrid = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qlev = new LinkedList<>();
        usedGrid[x][y] = true;
        qx.add(x);
        qy.add(y);
        qlev.add(0);
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        int base = n * n; // offset for sink nodes

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            int lev = qlev.poll();

            // if current cell is a digit sink, add edge from source to sink node
            if (Character.isDigit(b[cx][cy]) && b[cx][cy] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, base + cx * n + cy, INF);
            }

            if (lev >= t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = cx + dx[k];
                int ty = cy + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !usedGrid[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > lev + 1) {
                        qx.add(tx);
                        qy.add(ty);
                        qlev.add(lev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > lev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, base + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    usedGrid[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        a = new char[n][n];
        b = new char[n][n];

        br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            a[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            b[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        // Find zombie position
        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsDeath(zx, zy);

        int S = 2 * n * n;
        int T = 2 * n * n + 1;
        MaxFlow maxFlow = new MaxFlow(2 * n * n + 2);

        // Add edges from source to source cells
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // Add edges from sink cells to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0') {
                    maxFlow.addEdge(n * n + i * n + j, T, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS from each source cell
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0') {
                    runBFS(i, j, maxFlow);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
    }
}
